content.text: {"judgements":[{"id":"row1-ilo0-contentilo","label":"PARTIALLY_ALIGNED","explanation":"The target ILO is related to the source content, but it has several gaps. (1) \"To develop skills\" is not an observable, assessable student performance; it names no action the student can show. (2) \"both analog and digital circuits\" is broader than the source content, which covers electronic systems, design of circuits and differential amplifiers (differential gain, common mode gain, CMRR, configurations) and teaches no digital circuit content. (3) The ILO names neither the differential amplifier topics nor the electronic system design topics the week actually teaches, so it is too vague to guide teaching and assessment.
